searchText: is there a 7702 dedicated discord channel? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/718596092828057631 Do we have a spec for SSZ optionals? I mean one that's kind of agreed upon? There was https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6475 A counterproposal https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7495 Stable container is scheduled for inclusion not as far as i can tell? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7600 yeah probably there's not that much of a strong commitment? but it was agreed that teams will work to have them in the next devnet after 1 and teams are currently rushing for it StableContainers seem like an extremely complicated thing. Any ELI5? As to even why they are needed? I mean Union is in and nobody uses it, so Thanks <@543900561460822016> for the explianation (diff chan) Looking through the spects too, the stable container seems simple enough but you guys are piling legacy into ssz faster than into eth1 😛 FWIW, I'd vote against the Profiles. Seems like a microoptimization that doesn't really save a relevant amount but costs a lof of added complexity Setting the relevant data field to None in the StableContainer is essentially a Profile. The only size difference is the bitset in front, which profiles supposedly don't need But is that bitset relevant in size compared to the actual data being shuffled? Oops sorry was driving on a trip, the right person championing this is <@881905303011086387>. I have my own reservations, but I have to admit that giving contracts the chance to prove against blocks and not have to change on hardforks is a good one One of my concerns is with replacing fields instead, that becomes awkward/not covered
